profiles.label: Broader search
profiles.description: Include more possible moments for review. Analysis takes longer and can flag irrelevant objects.

profiles.label: Fast search
profiles.description: Purpose-trained compact detector (YOLOX-s, detector v4, trained on synthetic and real warehouse images). About a second per clip on CPU, but at an unseen real site it found only about a third of the forklifts; review the original footage.

profiles.label: Stricter search
profiles.description: Filter out lower-confidence detections. This can miss visible interactions; review the original footage.

profiles.label: Fast search (Stage I detector)
profiles.description: The Stage I YOLOX-tiny, trained on synthetic footage only. Kept so the Stage I results can be reproduced; it found none of the forklifts in our real-image tests. Not compiled for the UGen300.
